facts.text: Under the Toro Tuition Pledge launching in fall 2026, California undergraduates who qualify for Pell Grants receive guaranteed coverage for tuition and mandatory fees for four years (two years for transfers).

sources.title: CSUDH Launches Toro Tuition Pledge, Guaranteeing Free Tuition and Fees – CSUDH News
sources.quote: CSUDH has announced a new affordability initiative for incoming students: the Toro Tuition Pledge, which covers four years of costs for first-time, first-year students and two years for transfer students.
